event_summary: A pale rectangular piece on a black circular platform changes position and orientation while nearby objects remain visually still.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a wooden tabletop with a black circular platform on the right, a small pale rectangular piece on its top surface, a tilted metallic-looking object on the left with a purple hanging strip, and a black cord trailing from the platform. Across the video, the pale rectangular piece moves around the top of the black circular platform and rotates in appearance, at times extending partly beyond the platform edge, while the platform body, cord, metallic object, and purple strip show no clear visible displacement.

No scene cut or camera movement is visible at the start.
